files.ontology:
@prefix tm: <urn:todaymath:vocab:> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

tm:ContentEntity a owl:Class .
tm:TextbookConcept a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:ContentEntity .
tm:CourseSection a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf tm:ContentEntity .
tm:RegisteredEntity a owl:Class .
tm:Assertion a owl:Class .
tm:partOf a owl:ObjectProperty, owl:TransitiveProperty ;
  rdfs:domain tm:ContentEntity ; rdfs:range tm:ContentEntity .
tm:covers a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:projectsSourceSection a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:directPedagogicalPrerequisite a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:supports a owl:ObjectProperty .
tm:observedIn a owl:ObjectProperty .
files.rules:
{
  "profile": "tm-owlrl-1",
  "standard": "OWL 2 RL RDF-based rules, selected application constructs",
  "supportedConstructs": [
    "rdfs:subClassOf",
    "rdfs:subPropertyOf",
    "rdfs:domain",
    "rdfs:range",
    "owl:TransitiveProperty(partOf only)"
  ],
  "witnessRules": [
    "asserted",
    "cax-sco",
    "prp-spo1",
    "prp-dom",
    "prp-rng",
    "prp-trp"
  ],
  "rejectedConstructs": [
    "owl:sameAs",
    "owl:imports",
    "owl:equivalentClass",
    "owl:propertyChainAxiom",
    "owl:Restriction",
    "SWRL",
    "SHACL-JS",
    "caller ontology or shapes"
  ],
  "neverInferred": [
    "mastery",
    "causality",
    "transitive pedagogical prerequisite",
    "permission"
  ],
  "canonicalization": "UTF-8, fixed skolem IRIs for data, lexically sorted N-Quads; ontology/shapes use original file bytes. Not general RDF semantic canonicalization.",
  "sourcePredicates": [
    "partOf",
    "orderedBefore",
    "assessesDefinition",
    "containsProposition",
    "cardInUnit",
    "authoredPrerequisiteRecommendation",
    "editorialPrerequisite",
    "editorialSupport",
    "editorialContains",
    "courseSequence",
    "projectsSourceSection",
    "coversSourceSection",
    "representativeCard",
    "scriptUsesDefinition",
    "referencesSource",
    "partialCourseMapping",
    "generatesForSection"
  ]
}
